definitions.explanation: The master or owner of a house, establishment, or domain. Carries a traditional, slightly formal or literary tone.
The person who receives and entertains guests. Used in traditional or formal contexts.

examples.english: Who is the lord of this castle?

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧きた。
examples.english: The shop owner personally brought the food.

examples.japanese: {主|あるじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{荒|あ}れ→荒れる：04577_areru⟧⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧だった。
examples.english: The mansion without its master had been left to ruin for years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宴|うたげ}→宴：12286_utage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The host of the banquet greeted the guests.

examples.japanese: {主|あるじ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{客人|きゃくじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧。
examples.english: To entertain guests as the host.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶会|ちゃかい}→茶会：14116_chakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
examples.english: The host of the tea ceremony prepared each utensil with care.

notes:
A slightly literary or traditional word for 'master' or 'owner.' More formal and evocative than ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧, often used in storytelling, historical contexts, and descriptions of traditional settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ} — lord of a castle
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ} — shop owner/proprietor
- ⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ} — master of the mansion
- ⟦{宴|うたげ}→宴：12286_utage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主|あるじ} — host of a feast
- {主|あるじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧ — without its master/owner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧ — master; husband; proprietor (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧ — owner (of an object)
- ⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧ — pet owner
- ⟦{家主|やぬし}→家主：04079_yanushi⟧ — landlord

NOTE ON READINGS:
The kanji {主|あるじ} has several readings: あるじ (master/host — this entry), ぬし (owner, often in compounds like ⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧), and しゅ (on'yomi, in compounds like ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧).
